Acronyms:
ACSF ... Activity Concentration Scale Factor (7053,1009)
b ... Rescale Intercept (0028,1052)

DC ... Decay Correction (0054,1102)
GEDCDT ... GE private tag (0009,100D)
H ... Patient Size (0010,1020)
IBW ... ideal body weight (kg)
LBMx ... lean body mass (LBM / LBMJAMES128 / LBMJANMA; kg)
m ... RescaleSlope (0028,1053)
Manuf. ... Manufacturer (0008,0070)
P ... Pixel Data (7fe0,0010)
RPSDT ... Radiopharmaceutical Start Datetime (0018,1078)
RPST ... Radiopharmaceutical Start Time (0018,1072)
S ... Patient's Sex (0010,1040)
